question: Describe a situation where you pursued a goal despite initial pushback or skepticism.

raiseTranscript.text: On my first project I noticed our onboarding script was failing silently for new hires. I proposed adding better logging even though my mentor said it was low priority. I ran a small test on my own time and showed the error rates to the team.

They still weren't convinced so I asked for 30 minutes in the next retro to demo it. After seeing the data they agreed and we shipped it the following sprint. I learned to bring data instead of just ideas.
